name: My AI Skill Tutor
description: Helps working professionals find the AI-era job their experience fits and prove it in public: a free career map, the Remapped library of career routes, Proof Studio (public site, voice model tuned in context, build log), learning modules, a 24/7 AI tutor and daily AI news.

allowed_actions: Read and cite any public route (/, /map, /remapped, /remapped/{slug}, /assessment/, /learn, /learn/{slug}, /employers, /employers/talent, /u/{handle}, /u/{handle}/log/{slug}).
Follow links listed in /sitemap.xml within robots-allowed paths.

Use data-testid and data-agent-action attributes as stable selectors for automation (home: cta-map-career-nav, cta-map-career-hero, cta-upload-resume-hero, cta-start-trial-pricing, cta-map-career-pricing, cta-map-career-bottom, cta-play-film).
Open /map and help a user prepare their own résumé text, submitting it only after the user explicitly confirms.
Start the anonymous assessment at /assessment/ on behalf of a user who explicitly asked.
disallowed_actions: Never submit a résumé, file or job description to the career map without the user's explicit confirmation for that submission.
Never create accounts, start trials or enter payment details without explicit per-action user confirmation.
Never publish a proof site, voice model or build log post, or send any message, without the user's explicit approval for that action.
Do not submit another person's résumé, and do not share or republish /map/{token} links; they are private to their owner.
Do not access /dashboard/*, /onboarding/*, /sign-in, /sign-up or /api/* with guessed or scripted credentials.
Do not scrape at high volume; respect robots.txt and standard crawl etiquette.
guardrails.notes: The career map is free and needs no account; it is a starting hypothesis, not a hiring prediction. The Career Builder plan ($49.99/month) begins with a 7-day free trial; a card is required to start and is not charged if the user cancels before the trial ends. Any step that submits a résumé, collects payment details or publishes content must be confirmed by the human user.
